invariants.single_owner: Only the CONSYS provider changes shared power, reset, remap, EMI protection or reservation state.
invariants.first_error: Preserve the first primary errno and a separate containment errno; never aggregate errors arithmetically.
invariants.io_completion: Submitted I/O is not completed I/O; buffers and ownership stay held until a positive completion or quiescence witness.
invariants.release: No effect-bearing resource is released before observable firmware, IRQ, HIF and admitted DMA quiescence.
invariants.generation: Every operation revalidates the same nonzero owner and image generation.
invariants.retry: No automatic firmware, START, effect or radio retry is allowed in an epoch.
invariants.activation_failure: An activation rejection proven effect-free remains BOUND; a failed or partial activation after any attempted effect enters FAULT_HELD.
invariants.registration: FIRMWARE_READY is distinct from wireless registration; registration success alone enters READY and registration failure enters FAULT_HELD.
invariants.poison_basis: Effect history and ownership certainty determine poisoning; an errno name alone never authorizes passive release.
invariants.lifetime: Consumer callbacks, transaction objects, module/code lifetime and provider/client references remain held after any attempted effect through failed probe or unbind until owner-only quiescence reaches OFF.

states.entry_preconditions: No published client handle and no effect-bearing epoch.
states.success_evidence: Validated provider dependencies or passive binding allocation.
states.cleanup_obligations: Release only passive allocations acquired by the failing call.
states.retry_policy: Driver core may reprobe after a dependency or configuration change.

states.entry_preconditions: Provider handle, immutable firmware and complete plan are generation-bound; no hardware effect attempted.
states.success_evidence: All plan spans and resource identities validate without enabling hardware.
states.failure_state: BOUND if rejection is proven before every effect; otherwise FAULT_HELD
states.cleanup_obligations: Only a proven passive rejection permits passive release; attempted activation pins all callable objects and references.
states.retry_policy: A new bind may occur only after the old passive binding is destroyed; no retry follows an attempted effect.

states.entry_preconditions: Provider confirms powered downloader epoch, reset exclusion, HIF access, remap identity and client exclusion.
states.success_evidence: Readback-checked provider admission for the same generation.
states.cleanup_obligations: Provider retains all possible effects and callable lifetimes until quiescence.
states.retry_policy: No activation retry in this epoch.

states.entry_preconditions: One validated ordinary section was submitted under the current transaction and absolute deadline.
states.success_evidence: Transport reports completion and required CONFIG acknowledgement for exactly the submitted section.
states.cleanup_obligations: Do not free buffers or refund sequence; quiesce the transport.
states.retry_policy: No replay of a submitted section.

states.entry_preconditions: Every ordinary section completed once in image-table order.
states.success_evidence: Complete per-section completion ledger, not a Boolean.
states.cleanup_obligations: Retain epoch and image until quiescence.

states.entry_preconditions: Owner applied the reviewed writable region-18 policy once and preserved raw status.
states.success_evidence: Typed zero result for the admitted secure operation in the same generation.
states.cleanup_obligations: Attempt at most one admitted final restriction if ownership is unchanged.

states.entry_preconditions: One table-ordered confined EMI copy began under the current generation and deadline.
states.success_evidence: Copy completed with required visibility and bounded compare while AP access remains admitted.
states.cleanup_obligations: Treat an interrupted copy as possibly effective and retain mapping/protection.

states.entry_preconditions: Every EMI section completed exactly once in table order.
states.success_evidence: Complete copy ledger plus visibility evidence for the same image.
states.cleanup_obligations: Retain writable responsibility until seal or quiescence.

states.entry_preconditions: Owner applied final region-18 policy and revalidated generation after all copies.
states.success_evidence: Typed final-policy success distinct from copy completion.

states.entry_preconditions: START was marked attempted before I/O and the transport reports submission after complete ordinary and sealed EMI evidence.
states.success_evidence: Only START submission; no readiness, registration or runtime claim.
states.cleanup_obligations: Retain every firmware-consumable and callable resource while readiness is unknown.
states.retry_policy: Bounded readiness polling is allowed; START resubmission is forbidden.

states.entry_preconditions: Firmware readiness was independently observed before the deadline in the same owner generation; no wireless frontend is published yet.
states.success_evidence: Firmware readiness only, explicitly distinct from cfg80211/wiphy registration.
states.cleanup_obligations: Registration failure retains all effects and callable lifetimes until owner quiescence.
states.retry_policy: No registration retry in this epoch.

states.entry_preconditions: Firmware is ready and cfg80211/wiphy plus the normal net-device registration completed successfully.
states.success_evidence: Explicit wireless-registration success after separate readiness; compilation is insufficient.
states.cleanup_obligations: Block new work before draining existing operations.
states.retry_policy: No implicit recovery or radio reactivation.

states.entry_preconditions: New cfg80211/netdev work is blocked and all affected clients are coordinated.
states.success_evidence: Firmware cannot fetch EMI and IRQ, HIF and admitted DMA operations are idle.
states.cleanup_obligations: Retain resources and callable lifetimes on timeout, cancellation or uncertain completion.
states.retry_policy: Only the owner may continue the one bounded quiescence/recovery operation.

states.entry_preconditions: Quiescence is proven and provider reports coherent OFF after ordered release.
states.success_evidence: Positive quiescence plus provider-owned OFF result; a PM put alone is insufficient.
states.cleanup_obligations: Only now may failed-probe/unbind callbacks, transaction objects, module/code lifetime and provider/client references be released in dependency order.
states.retry_policy: Resume creates a new generation and repeats validation; it does not restore radio automatically.

states.entry_preconditions: An attempted effect failed or became partial, ownership was lost, I/O became late or uncertain, registration failed after firmware effects, or quiescence could not be proven.
states.success_evidence: No success is implied; exit requires a reviewed owner quiescence/OFF witness.
states.cleanup_obligations: Retain memory, mappings, buffers, callbacks, code and both sides' references needed to contain uncertain effects.
states.retry_policy: No automatic retry. One explicit owner recovery may transition only through QUIESCING.

error_classes.meaning: Required provider or dependency is not ready.
error_classes.effect_free_disposition: Remain passive only when the rejection is proven before every effect and ownership is intact.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: FAULT_HELD regardless of errno; retain callable and effect lifetimes.
error_classes.retry: Driver-core reprobe only after an effect-free dependency change.

error_classes.meaning: Compatible device or required resource is absent.
error_classes.effect_free_disposition: Remain passive only when the rejection is proven before every effect and ownership is intact.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: FAULT_HELD regardless of errno; retain callable and effect lifetimes.

error_classes.meaning: Required provider, secure operation or format is unsupported.
error_classes.effect_free_disposition: A preflight capability rejection may remain BOUND with no poison when no effect was attempted.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: A secure-operation call marked attempted before returning unsupported is possibly effective and enters FAULT_HELD.

error_classes.meaning: Malformed binding, plan, extent, alignment or policy.
error_classes.effect_free_disposition: Remain passive only when the rejection is proven before every effect and ownership is intact.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: FAULT_HELD regardless of errno; retain callable and effect lifetimes.
error_classes.retry: Only after corrected immutable input and passive release.

error_classes.meaning: Conflicting client, live epoch or recovery owns the resource.
error_classes.effect_free_disposition: Remain passive only when the rejection is proven before every effect and ownership is intact.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: FAULT_HELD regardless of errno; retain callable and effect lifetimes.
error_classes.retry: Caller may make a new request only after externally observed owner-state change.

error_classes.effect_free_disposition: A stale passive binding may be discarded only if it never attempted an effect.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: FAULT_HELD because ownership is uncertain; retain callable and effect lifetimes.
error_classes.retry: No retry in the stale epoch.

error_classes.meaning: Firmware record, acknowledgement, sequence or status is invalid.
error_classes.effect_free_disposition: Malformed passive firmware metadata may be rejected before activation.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: FAULT_HELD regardless of errno; retain callable and effect lifetimes.

error_classes.meaning: Transport, firmware or provider effect failed or completion is uncertain.
error_classes.effect_free_disposition: An effect-free provider capability failure may remain passive only with explicit proof.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: FAULT_HELD regardless of errno; retain callable and effect lifetimes.

error_classes.meaning: Absolute operation, readiness or quiescence deadline expired.
error_classes.effect_free_disposition: A pre-effect admission deadline may remain passive only if no operation began.
error_classes.after_effect_attempt: FAULT_HELD because timeout never proves cancellation; retain callable and effect lifetimes.
